title: Cap on bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi
summary: Bill 84 would cap bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi at five and keep them 1,000 feet apart. It went before the council in June and passed 9–0 in July.

timeline.text: Bill 84, capping bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi at five, passed 9–0.
